page.layout: One running head at the top. Below it, one table: years printed in the left margin beside groups of four names each, with the names in one column to the right. A ruled line separates each group. Foot of the scan: a gathering mark and the start of a word, cut off at the scan edge.; One narrow column of running text on the right side of the scan, with the page number at the top right. Left of it is the dark edge of the neighbouring page, with no printed text. Below the column, at the far left edge, is a fragment "han", which belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

p.i: Annus tumultibus infamis. Groninga quoq; seditione laboratū. Dissensio inter Ducē Geldriæ & civitatem composita.
Rursum plebs commota Groningæ. Et bellum resuscitatum in diœcesi Vltra-jectina.
Pax composita inter Carolū V. Cæs. & Carolū Geldrū.
Simultas inter Groninganos & Emdanos orta portorio Emdano.
Esena obsessa ab Ennone Comite Edsfardi F. eiq; dedita cum Balthasare.
Maria Ieverana authore Boiingo Oldersh. ab Ennone deficit.
Balthasar Esensis neglecto jurejurando in fidem Caroli Geldri se conferri, & bellū Ennoni movet.

page.notes: The years are printed in the left margin beside each group of names, so they belong to the table, not to the margin notes. The asterisk and bullet are printed marks. Reading "Everts f." in 1529 is doubtful because the line is cut at the scan edge. In 1525 and 1529 the printed "f." after Everts may be a long s; it is read as f. The word "Vlger" is read as "Ulger" under the u/v rule, as its first letter is a vowel. The foot of the scan shows a gathering mark and the start of a catchword; both are left out, as this part has no catchword or signature. The rest of the page is not in this part. The whole column is set in italic type; I have marked it as such throughout, though a few words may be roman. The "*" before "Copiæ" is printed as a paragraph mark and is kept as printed. The "Vltra-jectina" hyphen is a line-end hyphen and is kept. The "han" at the far left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is omitted.
